children.name: Eumilax
children.description: Eumilax — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Eumilax brandti
children.description:
External: Brown to dark brown with spots/flecks, marbling on mantle; thick skin with fine grooves; keel extends along entire dorsum to mantle; pneumostome (uniquely) anterior to midline of mantle and with raised edge; 3-part sole with lighter central region (Schütt 2010).

Internal: Short atrium; “bipartite penis” with a pointed stimulator in basal part, apical part ovate; long epiphallus; short, cylindrical spermatheca (Schütt 2010).

Juveniles: Very dark brown (Schütt 2010).

children.name: Eumilax intermittens
children.description:
External: Medium to large slugs; keel on entire dorsum; mantle more than 1/2 dorsum length; small tubercles all over upper body; pneumostome antemedial on mantle (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: No intestinal caecum; short, thin vas deferens; penis with apical short, rounded flagellum containing 2 pilasters fused at its base; very short penis; very long, curved appendix on penis; many oblique longitudinal ridges inside penis; retractor muscle attached to penis apex; long oviduct; very short vagina; spermatheca with very short duct (Schileyko 2003).

children.name: Svanetia
children.description: Svanetia — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Svanetia caucasica
children.description:
External: Small slugs; large mantle slightly less than 1/2 body length; pneumostome postmedial on mantle; keel at least 3/4 length of dorsum (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: Right ocular retractor passes under oviduct and penial retractor muscle; very short, thick vas deferens; short penis containing a large verge; short oviduct; spermatheca undifferentiated from its duct, muscular, tubular, and thick-walled (Schileyko 2003).

children.name: Metalimax
children.description: Metalimax — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Metalimax elegans Simroth, 1902
children.description:
External: Medium slugs with narrow bodies; keel present; mantle 1/3 body length with a broad cephalic shield and a pointed posterior end; pneumostome antemedial on mantle (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: 3-looped intestine with long caecum on third small loop; vas deferens attached about to apex to penis; long, tubular penis; no appendix or flagellum on penis; longitudinal pilaster inside penis; short oviduct; spermatheca with minimal duct (Schileyko 2003). .

children.name: Metalimax varius
children.description:
External: Medium slugs with narrow bodies; keel present; mantle 1/3 body length with a broad cephalic shield and a pointed posterior end; pneumostome antemedial on mantle (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: 3-looped intestine with long caecum on third small loop; vas deferens attached about to apex to penis; long, tubular penis; no appendix or flagellum on penis; longitudinal pilaster inside penis; short oviduct; spermatheca with minimal duct (Schileyko 2003). .

children.name: Caspilimax
children.description: Caspilimax — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Caspilimax keyserlingi
children.description:
External: Large slugs; variable in color; mantle <1/3 body length; pointed posterior edge of mantle; pneomostome post-medial on mantle; large cephalic shield; short keel (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: Right ocular retractor passes under oviduct and penial retractor muscle; no intestinal caecum; very short, thick vas deferens joins penis through an internal pore; globular penis contains a rounded stimulator and 1-2 large folds; penial retractor muscle on base of penis; thin sheath around lower 2/3 of penis; short oviduct with short folds inside; spermatheca small with short duct; no vagina (Schileyko 2003).
